statement.zh: 乌尔皇家墓地建筑、墓葬及相关出土（含已刊 PG 系列；组合级，不编造馆藏号）见 Woolley《乌尔发掘》II（1934）。
statement.en: At Ur, the Royal Cemetery architecture, burials, and related finds (including the PG series as published; assemblage-level, no invented museum numbers) are documented in Woolley Ur Excavations II (1934).
